هٰذِهِ أَيَّامُ رَفَاعٍ , and ↓ رِفَاعٍ ; (AA, ISk, Az, S, Mgh, * Msb, * K;) but As disallows the latter; (TA;) and Ks says, I have heard الجِرَام and الجَرَام, and their coordinates, [such as الصِّرَام and الصَّرَام, &c.,] but الرفاع with kesr I have not heard; (S, TA;) These are days of removal, or transport, of seed-produce from the place in
which it has been reaped, (TA,) or of carriage thereof after reaping, (S, Mgh, K,) to the place in which the grain is trodden out. (S, Mgh, K, TA.) [See 1, near the beginning.] ―
-b2- رَفَاعٌ, or ↓ رِفَاعٌ , (accord. to different copies of the K,) or each, (TA,) also signifies The storing-up of seed produce. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
